 Here is how that works in practice. If you trade $50 on the Warriors and the contract settles in your favor, you keep your trading proceeds and still receive the $75 bonus. If the contract does not settle in your favor, the $75 bonus still arrives once your $50 in trades is complete.

 You must register with the code to trigger the offer.
